lesson.name: Learn the Ruy Lopez Tricky Systems
lesson.description: Learn the key ideas in three tricky Ruy Lopez variations. This video covers the Schlieman Variation, the Exchange Variation, and the Open Variation. Each line is important, but you can play it well if you know the basics.
